**Maintenance window: Saturday December 5, 02:00–05:00 UTC** — Postgres 13 → 17 production cutover, approved by Maya Cohen [2].

Details for the notice/macro, from the same ticket (KES-398, the current reference):
- Staging rehearsal Friday Nov 27; customer notice (status page + in-app banner) goes out Saturday Nov 28; migration freeze from Thursday Dec 3 [2].
- Move from Nov 21 was decided because Maya didn't want to stack risk right after an incident and before the Fernhill go-live [4]; the new date sits after the Dec 1 go-live [2].
- Expected customer impact during the window: dashboards read-only for about 40 minutes during the connection-string switch; ingestion keeps buffering in Kafka, no data loss [1].

⚠️ Watch out for stale dates: the Slack announcement [3] and the Notion runbook [1] still say Nov 21 with a freeze from Nov 19 — the runbook is explicitly not updated yet, and KES-398 is the reference [2].
